intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Jacksonville for 2026, and here is what he found: 35 family events, 15 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (ZOOLights at the Jacksonville Zoo) through January 18, 2027 (JAX Artist Walk on Ice), with Holiday River Fest and the Light Boat Parade (November 28), the Mandarin Community Christmas Tree Lighting (December 4) and the Springfield Holiday Tree Lighting and Lantern Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Jacksonville

  • 35 Christmas events for kids in Jacksonville
  • 15 free events, including Holiday River Fest, the Jacksonville Light Boat Parade, the Mandarin Community Christmas Tree Lighting and Luminaria at The Cummer Museum
  • Meet Santa: Very Shrimpy Christmas at VyStar Ballpark (December 5), Santa Brunch at Congaree and Penn (December 21), Holiday on the Farm and Breakfast with Santa at the Community First Igloo
  • Parades and tree lightings: Jacksonville Light Boat Parade (November 28), Mandarin tree lighting (December 4) and the Springfield Holiday Tree Lighting and Lantern Parade (December 5)
  • Ice skating: JAX Artist Walk on Ice in Riverside (November 27 to January 18, 2027)
  • Season: November 20, 2026 to January 18, 2027
